title: Confirmed: Barcelona star Anthony Gordon named UEFA Champions League Player of the Week

title: Barcelona teenage starlet making major strides at La Masia after slow adaptation

title: Alex Campos shares emotional message after Barcelona debut: ‘Days that you dream of living’

As things stand, his debut is a solid step toward a rotation role, but it remains to be seen if he will secure a place in the starting XI.
